caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a light yellow-brown finish, featuring spindle legs and stretchers. The chair's backrest includes two horizontal slats; the upper slat has a floral or decorative motif in yellow and green, while the lower slat displays a symmetrical leaf pattern in similar colors. Both armrests curve outward and downward, and they are detailed with subtle yellow and brown shading, including small decorative motifs near the front ends. The seat appears woven, depicted with fine diagonal lines representing texture, and is light brown. The front apron of the seat has two elongated yellow ovals that accentuate its rounded form, echoed in a similar decorative strip along the lower rail at the front. The legs are turned, showing graduated thickness with accentuated points of yellow and brown, and the feet and horizontal stretchers are shaded to indicate dimension. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Hitchcock Armchair
